name: GetTreeIdentity
source: lane AC: a dword that identifies the tree an id resolves to (equal values: the same tree); with the opcode and the object id it is the record/replay key (0x575ed0 / 0x576e70). Test fakes answer it from the owner and the id

name: TryStartQueuedAction
source: lane AC: 0x52e0f0 (2,422 bytes, not ported). When the object is busy it sets the pending byte at object + 0x29c; cTSObject's CallTree glue (0x53d2d0) calls it with (0, 0) once the outermost tree call is over and clears the byte first

name: OnRunFinished
source: lane AC: 0x534600 (66 bytes): when the byte at object + 0x86 is set, compares two word pairs and calls slots 344 and 56 when they differ; called by cTSObject's RunToCompletion glue (0x5315a0) after a run with (its first argument, completed and asked-to-report)

name: OnRunStarting
source: lane AC: the subobject at sim + 0x70 (object + 0x74); cTSObject's RunToCompletion glue (0x5315a0) calls it before running when the byte at sim + 0x28c and its third argument are set
